messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (P2) - GEN API 500s on /v1/generate. Auto-bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1834567890. Paging on-call. Affected: hosted inference cluster us-west-2, several customers reporting elevated 500/502. Please join bridge and add timeline entries.

maya: on it. joining bridge now. taking lead for initial triage. can someone post first-hit graphs (error-rate, p95 latency) and any recent deploys?

ryan: joining. i can grab logs from the runtime nodes. no deploys from infra in the last 4 hours (checked CI). will tail /var/log/runtime/* and grep for exceptions.

olivia: quick note from support — 8 distinct customers filed errors starting ~202-03 UTC and growing. endpoints mostly /v1/generate and a few chat routes. error body: "internal_server_error: inference failed". attaching sample request id: req_0a3f2b.

ops-bot: Pager timeline entry added by @oncall: 2025-11-12T20:38:10Z - initial alert fired. 2025-11-12T20:39:05Z - Maya acked. 2025-11-12T20:40:12Z - Bridge created.

ryan: logs: seeing repeated stack traces from kernel-worker with "KVCacheLookupError: corrupt-prefix-metadata" and a handful of OOM tracebacks in aggregation-worker. snippet below:

```
2025-11-12T20:36:58Z runtime kernel[pid=4221] ERROR KVCacheLookupError: corrupt-prefix-metadata key=abc123
2025-11-12T20:36:58Z runtime kernel[pid=4221] Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/runtime/kernel.py", line 274, in handle_request
    result = self.kv_cache.lookup(prefix)
KVCacheLookupError: metadata checksum mismatch
2025-11-12T20:37:01Z aggregation-worker[pid=105] WARNING OutOfMemoryError: allocation failed while batching tokens
```

ryan: tail command used: `kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=kernel -f --since=15m | grep -E "KVCache|KVCacheLookupError|OutOfMemory"`

maya: good; that points at cache/caching layer. i want to reduce blast radius. immediate plan: 1) flip routing to bypass prefix cache for hosted tier (route->fallback no-cache) 2) scale up kernel pods by 2x to absorb OOMs 3) open a temporary fallback to smaller model variant for high QPS customers. who can flip the routing rule?

sam: i can flip rules. will run the routing change now (rolling update to router config). also starting scale for kernel pods. executing: `infractl router update --bypass-prefix-cache=true --selector=env=prod`

ops-bot: Action logged: routing bypass applied by sam at 2025-11-12T20:44:03Z. Kernel pod replica count increased from 6 -> 12 by autoscaler trigger.

leah: product note — we need wording for statuspage. are customers seeing degraded service or complete failures? how many requests affected?

olivia: current error budget burn: ~18% of last hour's requests affected, peak error rate 7% at 20:39 UTC. degraded but not full outage. some customers saw retries fail.

pm-jordan: i'll draft statuspage. please confirm wording: "We are investigating elevated 500 errors affecting the Generate API in US-West. Workaround applied to bypass request prefix cache; mitigation underway. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." ok to publish?

maya: ok to publish with one clarification: include impacted timeframe (started ~20:36 UTC). go ahead, pm-jordan — but hold until we confirm partial recovery metrics.

ryan: listing hypotheses to track in-RCA thread: H1: cache metadata corruption following async compaction job. H2: kernel scheduler regression in latest runtime kernel (but no deploy recorded?). H3: change in traffic patterns exposing race in KV cache reads. attaching link to compaction job logs: https://logs.redwood/compaction/2025-11-12/compaction-42

sam: assigning owners: H1 -> olivia (check compaction logs + checksum code), H2 -> runtime team (ryan), H3 -> maya (traffic pattern + chaos). please add timeline bullets as you validate.

olivia: quick findings: compaction job has one failed run at 20:33 UTC with checksum warnings; logs show a transient disk IO error on node ip-10-2-5-18 around 20:32:50Z. adding to timeline.

ops-bot: Timeline entry: 2025-11-12T20:32:50Z - disk IO error observed on storage node ip-10-2-5-18 (compaction job). 2025-11-12T20:36:58Z - first KVCacheLookupError observed in kernel logs. 2025-11-12T20:44:03Z - routing bypass applied.

ryan: running quick experiment: roll back cache checksum verification is risky, but i can disable compaction for the affected shard group to prevent further corruption while we investigate. will coordinate with storage.

maya: do it but only for shard-group sg-7. sam, can you coordinate a temporary knob so we don't disable compaction everywhere?

sam: doing that now: `storagectl compaction suspend --shard sg-7` — suspended at 20:49:12Z.

pm-jordan: statuspage draft updated and published (pending): "We have applied a mitigation to bypass our prefix cache for affected requests and are continuing investigations into underlying storage compaction errors. Impact: partial failures for Generate API; affected customers may see transient 500s. Next update in 30 minutes." publishing now.

leah: sending a customer note to top 10 impacted accounts (SRE-runbook): short summary + mitigation + ETA for next update. cc'ing support.

olivia: timeline so far (for RCA prep):
- 20:32:50Z storage node IO error on ip-10-2-5-18 (compaction job)
- 20:36:58Z first KVCacheLookupError in kernel logs (req_0a3f2b example)
- 20:39:00Z error spike observed (7% error rate)
- 20:44:03Z routing bypass applied (mitigation 1)
- 20:49:12Z compaction suspended for sg-7 (mitigation 2)
- 20:55:30Z error rate dropped to ~1.2% (partial recovery)

sam: i'll own the RCA writeup. plan to collect: full kernel logs (slice for 20:30-21:00), compaction job artifacts, storage IO metrics, and per-customer request traces. aim to have initial RCA draft in 72 hours. any objections?

maya: sounds good. one ask: runtime team please annotate any code paths that touch prefix metadata with timestamps to help correlate later. ryan can you add temporary verbose logging for 24h?

ryan: will push a targeted log flag to kernel (`--debug-prefix-metadata`) for the affected nodes only. deployment at 21:05Z.

pm-jordan: stakeholder update needed: exec update + customer list. who can pull the impacted customer list and ETA by 21:00Z?

leah: support will provide list by 20:58Z. i'll consolidate and hand to pm-jordan for exec note.

maya: closing loop for live incident: mitigation applied and error rate trending down. leaving this thread open for immediate follow-ups and RCA coordination. moving timeline and artifacts to #postmortem once initial data collected. thx everyone. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident log updated. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem channel: #postmortems.
